title: OpenHW CV32E41P

cv32e41p_cs_registers.note: unique case (1'b1) VIOLATION stimulus: the cex raises csr_save_id_i and csr_save_ex_i together (LRM: undefined); with csr_save_id_i = csr_save_if_i = 0 the seq-4 miter proves -- the same artefact as cv32e40p_cs_registers, not a reader defect

_note: The CORE-V CV32E41P: the RV32IMFC core with the PULP extensions -- the
4-stage pipeline, the ALU and its divider, the APU dispatcher, the CS
registers, the hardware loop controller and the OBI load / store unit.  Its
own cv32e41p_manifest.flist is the closure: rtl/include's three packages,
every rtl/*.sv, and bhv's simulation clock gate.
The last of the four OpenHW cores on the todo list (cv32e40p, cv32e40x and
cv32e40s are the others).  The RVFI tracer, core_log and the sva/ assertion
fpnew / common_cells / tech_cells_generic are Bender dependencies for the
FPU configuration only; the sweep reads the core at its own defaults, where
the FPU is not instantiated, so they are not roots here.  cv32e40p.json is
the family that sweeps the fpnew closure.
